ModMetaData.name: Project Vigilance - Geoscape & Early Warning
ModMetaData.author: Chris
ModMetaData.description: Overhauls planetary strategy with physical overland incursion transit, early-warning radar networks, multi-dish interferometry, caravan-deployable listening posts, and configurable haze of war. Eliminates instant map-edge raids in favor of realistic planetary movement, tiered contact intelligence, and global sensor networks. Fully era-agnostic with zero tech prerequisites.
